What Are Common Phonics Challenges for Kids

Many kids encounter common phonics challenges while learning to read. One challenge is letter-sound correspondence, where they may struggle to connect letters with their correct sounds. This can make decoding words difficult. 

Another hurdle is blending sounds to read words smoothly, as children may find it challenging to merge individual sounds into coherent words. Additionally, phoneme awareness, the ability to identify and manipulate individual sounds in words, can be tricky for some kids. This skill is crucial for spelling and reading comprehension. 

Sight words, often encountered in early reading, can pose a challenge too, as these words don't follow typical phonics rules and must be memorized by sight.
